institution: Right to Information Application to CPIO/SPIO
addressee_block:
The Central Public Information Officer (CPIO) / State Public Information Officer (SPIO)
[Department/Ministry Name]
[Office Address]
institution_rules: RTI applications must be addressed to the correct CPIO/SPIO of the public authority. Application fee is Rs. 10/- (rupees ten only) payable by IPO (Indian Postal Order), demand draft, or court fee stamp as prescribed by the authority. Below Poverty Line (BPL) applicants are exempt — attach BPL certificate. State each piece of information sought as a separate numbered point. Do NOT seek opinions, advice, or explanations — only factual information held by the authority. The authority must respond within 30 days (48 hours for life/liberty matters). NEVER invent sections beyond Section 6, 7, and 19 of the RTI Act without verification.
